name: H3C CNSSS - Arbitrary File Upload
author: s4e-io
description: H3C-Campus Network Self-Service System vulnerability allows for arbitrary file uploads. This enables attackers to upload any files they choose, acquire webshells, manipulate server permissions, and access sensitive information.
